mapper.sql: id, code, customer_id, address_id, address, status, delivery_amount, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted,receive_finish_time
mapper.select:
SELECT d.*, (SELECT syc2.name FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di2 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos2 ON syos2.id = di2.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo2 ON syo2.id = syos2.order_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer syc2 ON syc2.id = syo2.customer_id WHERE di2.delivery_id = d.id AND di2.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 ) as customerName, (select name from sto_yt_transport_company where id = d.transport_company_id) as transportCompanyName, (select url from sys_storage where id=d.transport_order_file_id) as transportOrderFileUrl, (SELECT nick_name FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = ( SELECT syc3.belong_employee_id FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di3 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos3 ON syos3.id = di3.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo3 ON syo3.id = syos3.order_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer syc3 ON syc3.id = syo3.customer_id WHERE di3.delivery_id = d.id AND di3.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 )) as salesEmployeeName FROM sto_yt_delivery d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di WHERE di.delivery_id = d.id AND di.is_deleted = 0 )
AND d.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di4 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos4 ON syos4.id = di4.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo4 ON syo4.id = syos4.order_id WHERE di4.delivery_id = d.id AND di4.is_deleted = 0 AND syo4.is_collected_shipping_cost = #{isCollectedShippingCost} )
AND d.customer_id = #{customerId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di5 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos5 ON syos5.id = di5.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo5 ON syo5.id = syos5.order_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer syc5 ON syc5.id = syo5.customer_id WHERE di5.delivery_id = d.id AND di5.is_deleted = 0 AND syc5.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di6 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos6 ON syos6.id = di6.order_sub_id WHERE di6.delivery_id = d.id AND di6.is_deleted = 0 AND syos6.sub_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subCode}, '%') )
AND d.address_id = #{addressId}
AND d.status = #{status}
AND d.receive_status = #{receiveStatus}
AND d.package_code like concat('%', #{packageCode} ,'%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di7 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos7 ON syos7.id = di7.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo7 ON syo7.id = syos7.order_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer syc7 ON syc7.id = syo7.customer_id WHERE di7.delivery_id = d.id AND di7.is_deleted = 0 AND syc7.belong_employee_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{salesEmployeeName},'%')) )
AND d.transport_company_id in (select id from sto_yt_transport_company where name like concat('%',#{transportCompanyName},'%'))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di8 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos8 ON syos8.id = di8.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo8 ON syo8.id = syos8.order_id WHERE di8.delivery_id = d.id AND di8.is_deleted = 0 AND syo8.id = #{orderId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sto_yt_delivery_item di9 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos9 ON syos9.id = di9.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order syo9 ON syo9.id = syos9.order_id WHERE di9.delivery_id = d.id AND di9.is_deleted = 0 AND syo9.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderCode}, '%') )
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

select GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT syo.code SEPARATOR ', ') as orderCode FROM sto_yt_delivery_item as sydi left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = sydi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id WHERE sydi.delivery_id = #{id} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0

select nick_name from sys_user where user_id in (select sale_employee_id from sal_yt_order where id in ( select order_id from sal_yt_order_sub where id in( select order_sub_id from sto_yt_delivery_item where delivery_id=#{id}) ))

SELECT DISTINCT d.*, (select url from sys_storage where id = transport_order_file_id) as transport_order_file_url, (select name from sto_yt_transport_company where id= transport_company_id) as transport_company_name FROM sto_yt_delivery d LEFT JOIN sto_yt_delivery_item di ON d.id = di.delivery_id AND di.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status = '2'
AND di.order_sub_id = #{orderSubId}
AND di.order_sub_id in (select id from sal_yt_order_sub where is_deleted=0 and order_id = #{orderId})
AND d.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deliveryCode}, '%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(d.delivery_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{deliveryTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND di.product_id in ( SELECT id FROM pro_yt_product p WHERE p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%') and p.is_deleted=0 )
